policy: Family photographs only where a documented clean external outer-back scan remains unavailable.

back.editionNote: Back of the family copy. No usable documented external outer-back scan was found. The original photograph was cropped and corrected for perspective; natural lighting and wear are retained.
back.visualReview: Manually reviewed full-size before integration: outer-back perimeter, upright readable text, no tabletop, labels or inner pages substituted.
back.processing: Original HEIC decoded with EXIF orientation; reviewed outer-jacket quadrilateral optically rectified, rotated upright, converted to sRGB and exported at 2200px. Capture metadata omitted. Printed artwork, wear and lighting retained.
